BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fiscal matters; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The purpose of this act is to take the firststep toward balancing the state's 200911 operating budget by capturingearly savings prior to the adoption of the 2010 supplemental omnibusappropriations act.
